text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka and I are visiting a shrine together…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm! I sense an aura of bad luck coming from you, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No! Our meeting here is destiny!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was commanded by the heavens to go and pray that Suzuka's bad luck be cleansed!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, simply do as I do. Now, watch closely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haiya, woiya! Awe-awe aye-aye, hoppity-mag! May she be blessed with good fortune multiplied to abundance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, now, now! Give it a try, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: M-me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But of cooourse!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I appreciate the offer, but I think I'd prefer to do it the usual way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, begin! Haiya!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haiyaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, h-haiya?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Woiya!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Woiya?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! I feel a positive aura! You should be much better now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Surely this won't have any real effect…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aha ha ha! ♪ Good things come to those who believe!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haiya, woiya…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-impossible… I actually feel a lot better!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What's that? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: N-no, it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether it's thanks to the strange prayer or not, Silence Suzuka is in great form at her next practice.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Yes, you have been blessed. How do you feel, Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I don't feel any different from normal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meow…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw! Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaah! It's a whole flock of bad luck! Black cats and crows!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder if someone’s been feeding them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We can't be sure it's due to bad luck, but Silence Suzuka's condition remains poor throughout our next training session.
